title: Harden x509 appendix verifier semantics
description: Codereview findings (kimi-k3, security+edge passes) against spec/appendix-x509-cert-profile.md created in viku.1; these change verifier-behavior requirements (§8): (1) the key-to-address binding check (§8 step 4) compares only the lower 64 bits — MUST recompute the full 16-byte native address ([0x02]+SHA-512(pubkey)[0:7]+IID) and compare all 128 bits, otherwise a cert with arbitrary upper bytes passes while attesting an address the node does not own; (2) wholesale chain replacement has no freshness ordering — a node re-issued a reduced cert can re-present its older still-valid chain and roll verifiers back (last-presented-wins); add a replace-only-if-newer rule (e.g. strictly later notBefore/notAfter, reject older chains); (3) role extension is not scoped to authorized anchors — any chain to ANY configured trust anchor (incl. the optional public default CA) would satisfy lichen:relay=true by default, promoting every identity anchor to a mesh-wide forwarding grantor and contradicting the gateway-local lichen:relay local-fact model (06-security.md 8.13.1); add normative text that role-bearing anchors MUST be separately configured and that absence of role assertion must not be read as leaf.
close_reason: Fixed all 3 findings in spec/appendix-x509-cert-profile.md §6/§8 (+ §5). (1) §8 step 4 now recomputes the FULL 128-bit native address ([0x02]+SHA-512(pubkey)[0:7]+IID, U/L cleared) and requires exactly one native 0200::/8 SAN entry matching it (was lower-64-only, and 'the SAN native /128' singular was ambiguous) — closes the substitution hole. (2) New 'Role-assertion trust scope' subsection: role extension honored ONLY for chains to a deployment-configured role-granting anchor; identity-only anchors (incl. public default CA) give key-to-address binding but no role — fail-closed, consistent with lichen:relay local-fact model; §5 satisfaction sentence cross-references the scope. (3) §6+§8 step 6 freshness ordering: replace cached chain only if leaf notBefore strictly later AND cached still valid; cached-fresher-chain drives binding/role decisions (anti-rollback); expired cached chain discarded; future-notBefore entry can't suppress a valid presented chain; cache key defined (per subject key/address); same-day-tie caveat documented, accept-on-tie forbidden. 3x codereview (kimi-k3 via opencode): pass1 correctness=PASS on A, 2 findings on B/C (fixed inline); pass2 security=2 findings (decision-not-bound rollback, exactly-one-native) fixed inline; pass3 edge=4 findings (expired-cache re-validation P1, future-notBefore poisoning, cache-key def, tie wording) fixed inline; confirmation re-review=1 residual (step6 'expired' vs §6 'outside validity window') fixed inline. Converged.
